ABOUT UNTAMED

Connecting people with unforgettable guided experiences

Untamed is a New Zealand marketplace designed to make it easier to discover and book trusted guided fishing, hunting and back country experiences across the country.

ABOUT US

What Untamed is about

Untamed brings customers and independent guides together in one place. Customers can explore guided trips, compare experiences and book directly through the platform, while guides can showcase their services, availability and experience.

Our goal is to help people experience more of New Zealand through knowledgeable local guides while giving guides a simple way to reach customers and manage bookings.

CONTACT US

How can we help?

Have a question about a guided trip, booking, or becoming a Untamed guide? You can email us directly at:

thebookpioneer@gmail.com

For booking questions, include the trip name and booking reference if you have one.

TERMS & CONDITIONS

Using Untamed

Untamed provides a marketplace that connects customers with independent guides and outdoor experience providers. Guides are responsible for the accuracy of their listings, availability, pricing, safety requirements, licences, permits and the delivery of their guided experience.

Customers are responsible for providing accurate booking information, following the guide’s instructions, meeting any age, fitness, licence or equipment requirements, and advising the guide of any information that may affect participation in the experience.

A booking is only confirmed once the applicable booking process has been completed. For Instant Book trips this includes successful payment. For Request to Book trips, the guide must first accept the request and any required payment must then be completed.

Cancellation, refunds & date changes

Untamed payment & cancellation policy: A 20% non-refundable deposit is required at the time of booking. The remaining 80% balance is due 30 days before the trip. Bookings made within 30 days of the trip require full payment at the time of booking. If the guest cancels more than 30 days before the trip, the 20% deposit is retained and no further payment is required. If the guest cancels within 30 days of the trip, payments are non-refundable. If the guide cancels, the guest will receive a full refund. For cancellations caused by weather, river conditions, access closures, or other circumstances outside the guest’s or guide’s control, the guide may offer a rescheduled date or trip credit, with any refund handled according to the circumstances.

No shows: If the customer does not attend the booked experience, no refund is provided.

Weather, river, access or safety conditions: If the guide decides conditions are unsuitable or unsafe, the guide and customer may agree to move the booking to another suitable date, or the guide may approve a full refund.

Guide cancellation: If the guide cancels the experience and a new date is not agreed, the customer receives a full refund.

Any rights that apply under New Zealand law continue to apply.

Outdoor activities such as hunting, fishing and back country travel carry inherent risks. Customers participate at their own risk and must follow all safety instructions provided by their guide.

These terms are a general platform summary and may be updated as Untamed develops. A more detailed legal version should be reviewed before the app is publicly launched.

FOR NEW ZEALAND GUIDES

Put your guiding business in front of more travellers.

Untamed connects tourists and outdoor travellers with guides throughout New Zealand. Whether you offer fly fishing, hunting, back country adventures, helicopter accessed trips, day tours or multi day experiences, Untamed gives customers one place to discover and book local guides.

WHY USE UNTAMED?

Connect with tourists looking for local guides.

  • No charges without results – Let us bring clientele to you. If you don’t get a completed booking there are no charges.
  • Reach travellers – Be found by tourists actively looking for guided New Zealand experiences.
  • Multiple listings – Add separate day trips, multi day trips, back country experiences and different locations.
  • Showcase your profile – Add photos, bio, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube and your own website.
9% + GSTone off fee per booking

No added fees.

Untamed charges one booking fee of 9% + GST. There are no extra listing or platform fees added on top.
